subject: chapter
summary: First edition: 68 fundamental papers in 10 groups (Foundations with 29 papers, then one group per trend) and a map of how they build on, answer or evaluate each other.

subject: chapter rules
summary: The owner reviewed the list: both one-paper groups stay (Text2Cypher; Knowledge Compounding), and the papers behind WordNet, YAGO, DBpedia, Freebase and Wikidata stay in Foundations as a named exception to the rule on dataset papers.

subject: Semantic web standards
summary: New group of 5 fundamental papers for the trend Semantic web standards, added at the owner's review: the formal semantics of SPARQL (2006), three papers of the RDF-star line (2014, 2014, 2017) and a semantics of recursive SHACL (2018, a weak pass). The chapter now has 73 fundamental papers in 11 groups.
